description: Crypto news from seven public feeds, each item labelled when it appeared ($0.003 USDC): assets, sentiment (bullish/bearish/neutral), relevance, category, plus counts per sentiment and per asset. Labels by an open model on AI Power Grid; they say what the news claims, not what the price will do.

asset.description: only items about this ticker, e.g. BTC

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

name: get_crypto_news
